records.subject: Welcome aboard, Blue Partners
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

I've sent a couple of notes and don't want to crowd your inbox, so this is my last nudge for now.

If it's useful: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'll walk through it with you and answer anything else as we go. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
